turns.user: where do I upload my progress photos
turns.reply:
That feature actually doesn't exist in the app—there isn't a progress photo gallery or upload option. 

If you are looking to track how your body is changing, the best tool we have in the app is the weight trend, which you can see right on your Home tab. 

Are you hoping to track your physical changes for a specific goal, or did you just want a place to store those photos?

turns.user: there's really nowhere to put them?
turns.reply:
No, there really isn't any upload or storage space for photos in the app. 

Most people I coach who use progress photos tend to keep a private folder on their phone's camera roll or use a dedicated tracking app just for their gallery. It keeps things simple and keeps your photos entirely in your own hands.

If you're looking to see how your body composition is shifting, we can still use your strength trends on the Exercise tab and that weight trend on the Home tab to see exactly how you're progressing. 

Are you focusing on leaning out or building muscle at the moment?
